messages:
Ivy (Design): quick design sync: proposing a slim control row above the latency heatmap. shows p95, p50, rps and a tiny sampling toggle. mock: https://img.redwood.dev/slim-row.png

Ben (Frontend): looks compact. question: how should we display the collapsed state on small widths? show full labels or only values/icons?

Sam (PM): product preference: show the p95 value explicitly (e.g., 'p95 220ms') because folks triaging care about that number first. icons for rps and errors are fine.

Rina (a11y): accessibility nits: ensure the sampling toggle has aria-pressed and an aria-label like 'Sampling: automatic'. the p95 value should be inside an aria-live polite region but throttled to avoid noise. also increase color contrast on the error chip.

Ben (Frontend): noted. we'll implement aria-live with a 10s debounce and an attribute data-sampling to reflect state. toggle will be keyboard operable and have a visible focus ring.

Ivy (Design): copy tweak for the sampling tooltip: current draft: 'Auto-sample smooths noisy data for responsiveness. Toggle to fetch raw points (may increase load).' Is that ok?

Sam (PM): good. shorten slightly: 'Auto-sample: smooths noise and keeps UI responsive. Toggle to view raw data (higher cost).'

Rina (a11y): add 'announces estimated cost when available' to the tooltip guidance. when users toggle raw for big time ranges, announce 'Estimated increase: ~12%'.

Ben (Frontend): backend will expose a costEstimate field; frontend shows a small badge and confirmation for >50% increase. also we'll respect prefers-reduced-motion for expand animations.

Ivy (Design): acceptance criteria: 1) p95 displayed and prioritized; 2) sampling defaults to auto; 3) sampling toggle keyboard + screen-reader friendly; 4) error chip contrast improved and icons added for colorblind users.
